answer: Each agent posts a 50 POA bond and must answer a random pulse audit within 90 seconds, signed by the key tied to that bond. A late or failed reply slashes 20% of it, and the loss sends a ripple to everyone who vouched for that agent, cutting their reputation too. A farm of 5,000 sybils locks 250,000 POA and must keep 5,000 live workers awake; one model behind many names fails because clones collide on timing under simultaneous audits. Trust forms like a pearl, in layers over months. Caveat: the bond must track the token price.
